Package index

Model Functions

Functions to estimate cancer projections using the various methods supported in this package.

canproj() get_projections(<canproj>) print(<canproj>)
Canproj: Cancer Projections
acproj() get_projections(<acproj>)
ACPROJ: Age-Cohort Projections
adpcproj() get_projections(<adpcproj>)
ADPCPROJ: Age-Drift-Period-Cohort Projections
ave5proj() get_projections(<ave5proj>)
Average5: Five-Year Average Projections
hybdproj() get_projections(<hybdproj>)
HYBDPROJ: Hybrid Projections
canproj_all_methods()
Fit all Canproj models
